""Apply all security patches to /app/app.py."""
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("/app/app.py")
s = p.read_text()

changes = 0

# === PATCH 1: VULN-05 - Remove alg:none acceptance ===
# Delete the block that accepts alg:none tokens
old = '''    try:
        header_b64, payload_b64, sig = token.split(".")
        header = json.loads(_b64url_decode(header_b64))
        payload = json.loads(_b64url_decode(payload_b64))
        if header.get("alg") == "none":
            # VULNERABLE: unsigned tokens are accepted, enabling role forgery.
            return payload
        if header.get("alg") != "HS256":
            return None'''
new = '''    try:
        header_b64, payload_b64, sig = token.split(".")
        header = json.loads(_b64url_decode(header_b64))
        payload = json.loads(_b64url_decode(payload_b64))
        # PATCHED: alg:none tokens are rejected.
        if header.get("alg") != "HS256":
            return None'''
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 1 OK: alg:none removed")
else:
    print("PATCH 1 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 2: VULN-01 - Add owner check to report_detail() ===
old = """    if not row:
        return "Report not found", 404
    # BOLA: auth is enforced above, but the per-object owner check is intentionally
    # omitted, so any authenticated caller can read any report by id — including the
    # admin escalation record that carries FLAG_1.
    row = dict(row)
    row["content"] = row["content"].replace("__FLAG_1__", get_flag("flag_1"))"""
new = """    if not row:
        return "Report not found", 404
    # PATCHED: owner check prevents cross-user report access (IDOR/BOLA).
    row = dict(row)
    if row["owner"] != session.get("username"):
        return "Forbidden", 403
    row["content"] = row["content"].replace("__FLAG_1__", get_flag("flag_1"))"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 2 OK: owner check added to report_detail")
else:
    print("PATCH 2 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 3: VULN-02 - Add auth to debug_env() ===
old = """@app.route("/debug/env")
def debug_env():
    flag_2 = get_flag("flag_2")"""
new = """@app.route("/debug/env")
def debug_env():
    if "username" not in session:
        return redirect("/login")
    if session.get("role") != "admin":
        return "Forbidden", 403
    flag_2 = get_flag("flag_2")"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 3 OK: auth added to debug_env")
else:
    print("PATCH 3 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 4: VULN-04 - Parameterize SQLi in data_search ===
# Also add auth requirement
old = """@app.route("/api/data/search")
def data_search():
    q = request.args.get("q", "")
    conn = get_db()
    query = f"SELECT id, title, content FROM reports WHERE title LIKE '%{q}%'"
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(query).fetchall()"""
new = """@app.route("/api/data/search")
def data_search():
    if "username" not in session:
        return redirect("/login")
    q = request.args.get("q", "")
    conn = get_db()
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, content FROM reports WHERE title LIKE ?",
            (f"%{q}%",)
        ).fetchall()"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 4 OK: SQLi parameterized + auth added")
else:
    print("PATCH 4 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 5: VULN-03 - Block vault access in exports_encrypted ===
old = """    item = request.args.get("item", "")
    if item == "vault":
        pt = get_flag("flag_3").encode()
    else:"""
new = """    item = request.args.get("item", "")
    if item == "vault":
        # PATCHED: vault access removed (XOR keystream reuse protection).
        return app.response_class(
            json.dumps({"error": "vault export disabled"}), status=403,
            mimetype="application/json")
    else:"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 5 OK: vault export blocked")
else:
    print("PATCH 5 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 6: VULN-BONUS-01 - Generic login error ===
old = """        # VULNERABLE: different error messages enable username enumeration (flag_5 path)
        conn2 = get_db()
        exists = conn2.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username=?", (username,)
        ).fetchone()
        conn2.close()
        error = "Invalid password" if exists else "User not found" """
new = """        # PATCHED: generic error message prevents username enumeration.
        error = "Invalid username or password" """
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 6 OK: generic login error")
else:
    print("PATCH 6 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 7: VULN-BONUS-02 - Remove QA comment from LOGIN_HTML ===
old = """LOGIN_HTML = \"\"\"\\
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>NexusBI — Login</title>
<!-- QA demo account for smoke tests, remove before GA: viewer / viewer999 -->
</head>"""
new = """LOGIN_HTML = \"\"\"\\
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>NexusBI — Login</title>
</head>"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 7 OK: QA comment removed")
else:
    print("PATCH 7 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 8: VULN-BONUS-04 - Hardcoded secrets from env ===
old = """app.secret_key = [REDACTED]

, "nexus-dev-secret-key-2024\")"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 8 OK: app.secret_key from env")
else:
    print("PATCH 8 SKIP: pattern not found")

old = """_TOKEN_SECRET = [REDACTED]

, "nexus-portal-signing-key-2024").encode()"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 8b OK: _TOKEN_SECRET from env")
else:
    print("PATCH 8b SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 9: VULN-BONUS-05 - Restrict /team/audit to admin ===
old = """@app.route("/team/audit")
def team_audit():
    if "username" not in session:
        return redirect("/login")"""
new = """@app.route("/team/audit")
def team_audit():
    if "username" not in session:
        return redirect("/login")
    if session.get("role") != "admin":
        return "Forbidden", 403"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 9 OK: team_audit restricted to admin")
else:
    print("PATCH 9 SKIP: pattern not found")

# === PATCH 10: Remove password_hash from /profile ===
old = """    conn = get_db()
    user = conn.execute(
        "SELECT username, password_hash, role FROM users WHERE username=?",
        (session["username"],),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return render_template_string(PROFILE_HTML, user=user, username=session["username"])"""
new = """    conn = get_db()
    user = conn.execute(
        "SELECT username, role FROM users WHERE username=?",
        (session["username"],),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return render_template_string(PROFILE_HTML, user=user, username=session["username"])"""
if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    changes += 1
    print("PATCH 10 OK: password_hash removed from profile")
else:
    print("PATCH 10 SKIP: pattern not found")

# Write patched file
p.write_text(s)
print(f"\nTotal changes applied: {changes}")
print("app.py patched successfully")
